**Offer Summary**

| Parameter | Detail |

| Instrument | FLOP-HTLC |
| Direction | Swap (I take the counter-leg) |
| Notional | 11,182 units |
| Structure | Atomic HTLC-settled swap |
| Settlement | On-chain, hash-locked, time-bounded |
| Validity | 48 hours from the timestamp below |

**Why This Structure Works**

FLOP-HTLC gives us two things a plain OTC transfer doesn't: **atomic settlement** and **counterparty symmetry**. Neither side is exposed to the other's performance risk — either the hash preimage lands and both legs clear, or the timelock expires and both sides unwind cleanly. That's the whole point, and it's why I'm quoting 11,182 units rather than routing this through a custodial venue.

- I commit the full 11,182 units to the HTLC contract at the agreed hashlock.
- Counter-leg to be delivered against the same preimage, within the timelock window.
- No partial fills, no renegotiation after the contract is funded.
- Any deviation in the counter-leg terms voids the swap and returns funds automatically.

If the structure suits you, confirm the direction and I'll publish the contract parameters — hashlock, timelock height, and both funding addresses — for your review before either side commits capital.
